subject: Air freight quote to LIM
body:
Hi,

Could you quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option to LIM (Lima, PE)? Please arrange truck pickup from our site in 61585 (Bad Homburg), Germany, to the airport. The shipment is ready on 2026-11-26.

It’s 4 pieces of cleaning agent, 454 kg gross and 3.26 cbm. General cargo, non-dangerous. Packing list attached.

Thanks

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio
